mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 'approved' WHEN ea.approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'pending' END
mapper.select: SELECT ea.approval_id AS id, CASE WHEN ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' THEN '휴가' WHEN ea.doc_type = 'OVERTIME' THEN '연장근무' WHEN ea.doc_type = 'FLEXIBLE' THEN '재택근무' WHEN ea.doc_type = 'TRIP' THEN CASE WHEN bd.trip_type = 'BUSINESS_TRIP' THEN '출장' ELSE '외근' END END AS type, CASE WHEN ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(vd.vacation_type, '휴가'), ' 신청') WHEN ea.doc_type = 'OVERTIME' THEN '연장근무 신청' WHEN ea.doc_type = 'FLEXIBLE' THEN COALESCE(ea.title, '재택근무 신청') WHEN ea.doc_type = 'TRIP' THEN CONCAT( CASE WHEN bd.trip_type = 'BUSINESS_TRIP' THEN '출장' ELSE '외근' END, ' 신청') END AS title, CASE WHEN ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' THEN CASE WHEN DATE(vd.start_dt) = DATE(vd.end_dt) THEN DATE_FORMAT(vd.start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(vd.start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(vd.end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d')) END WHEN ea.doc_type = 'OVERTIME' THEN CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(od.start_tm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(od.end_tm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) WHEN ea.doc_type = 'FLEXIBLE' THEN CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(fd.start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(fd.end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) WHEN ea.doc_type = 'TRIP' THEN CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(bd.start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(bd.end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) END AS period, CASE WHEN ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' THEN vd.reason WHEN ea.doc_type = 'OVERTIME' THEN od.reason WHEN ea.doc_type = 'FLEXIBLE' THEN fd.reason WHEN ea.doc_type = 'TRIP' THEN bd.reason END AS reason, AS status, DATE_FORMAT(ea.draft_dt, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS appliedAt, CASE WHEN ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' THEN DATE_FORMAT(vd.start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') WHEN ea.doc_type = 'OVERTIME' THEN DATE_FORMAT(od.work_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END AS targetDate, COALESCE( ( SELECT al.approver_name FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY al.approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT al.approver_name FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status IN ('COMPLETE', 'REJECTED', 'HOLD') ORDER BY al.approved_dt DESC, al.approval_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ), '-' ) AS approver, ( SELECT al.reason FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status IN ('REJECTED', 'HOLD') AND al.reason IS NOT NULL AND al.reason != '' ORDER BY al.approved_dt DESC, al.approval_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS rejectReason FROM electronic_approval ea LEFT JOIN vacation_detail vd ON vd.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN overtime_detail od ON od.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN flexible_work_detail fd ON fd.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN business_trip_detail bd ON bd.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.doc_type IN ('VACATION', 'OVERTIME', 'FLEXIBLE', 'TRIP') AND ea.approval_status != 'TEMP' ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status IN ('PENDING', 'HOLD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.doc_type IN ('VACATION', 'OVERTIME', 'FLEXIBLE', 'TRIP') AND ea.approval_status != 'TEMP'
